title: BanglaRAG-Eval benchmark record
description: Canonical schema for one benchmark example. A record is created at question-construction time and progressively enriched by later pipeline stages (retrieval, generation, human annotation, adjudication, automatic evaluation). Fields that a later stage fills are nullable/empty until that stage runs. Human annotation fields are NEVER populated automatically; automatic evaluator results live exclusively in evaluator_outputs.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record conforms to.

example_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this example.

document_id.description: Identifier of the source document the question was constructed from.

source_id.description: Identifier of the source collection/corpus (e.g. a fixture set, Bangla Wikipedia slice, curated document set).

question.description: The question posed to the RAG system.

question_language.description: Surface language/script of the question text itself. 'banglish' = Bangla expressed in Latin/Roman characters.

language_condition.description: Experimental language condition of the example as a whole. Banglish (romanized Bangla) is a DISTINCT condition and must not be collapsed into code_mixed. 'english' is a control baseline only.

data_origin.description: True provenance of the example content, independent of the experimental condition it represents.

source_text.description: The original source passage the question and intended answer are grounded in. Preserved verbatim for provenance even when retrieval is corrupted.

source_span.description: Character span (NFC-normalized offsets) in source_text that grounds the intended answer. Null if not span-localized.

intended_answer.description: The answer the question was designed to elicit, traceable to source_span. Used for question-generation provenance, never as a faithfulness gold label.

retrieved_context.description: Exact concatenated context string shown to the generator. Null until the retrieval stage has run.

retrieval_documents.description: The individual retrieved passages, in rank order. Empty until retrieval has run.

retrieval_configuration.description: Full retrieval configuration dump (top_k, index version, analyzer, etc.) for reproducibility. Free-form object; the common fields also appear flat below.

evidence_condition.description: Controlled evidence condition this example represents, stored explicitly at construction time (never inferred later).

evidence_condition_notes.description: How the evidence condition was constructed or verified for this example.

generated_answer.description: Exact answer produced by the generator. Null until the generation stage has run.

answer_claims.description: Optional decomposition of the generated answer into atomic claims.

faithfulness_category.description: GOLD faithfulness category. Derived exclusively from human annotation: must equal adjudication.label when an adjudication exists, or the unanimous label of >= 2 independent annotators otherwise (rule R3). Never populated by any automatic evaluator, including SemFuse, RAGAS, or LLM judges.

hallucination_type.description: Optional finer-grained hallucination type assigned during human annotation/adjudication (RAGTruth-inspired, provisional). Human-assigned only: requires human annotation provenance on the record (rule R9).

annotations.description: Independent human annotations (at least two independent annotators before adjudication). Entered by humans only.

method.description: How the disagreement was resolved: an independent third rater (adjudicator_id must differ from the annotators, rule R8) or a joint session of the annotators (adjudicator_id identifies who recorded the consensus).

adjudication.description: Human resolution of annotator disagreement. Required when independent annotations disagree; when annotators agree unanimously, the unanimous label itself becomes gold and no adjudication record is created (rule R3). Only valid after >= 2 independent annotations exist.

generator_version.description: Exact version/identifier of the generator model.

generation_settings.description: Decoding settings (temperature, max_tokens, etc.) used for generation.

embedding_model.description: Embedding model used by dense retrieval, if any.

prompt_version.description: Version identifier of the prompt template used for generation.

question_generation.description: Provenance of the question itself (human-written vs model-generated, and with what).

corruption_metadata.description: Present iff the retrieved evidence was deliberately corrupted. Original evidence is preserved in source_text / original_context_ids; corruption is never silent.

evaluator_outputs.description: Outputs of automatic evaluators. These are the SYSTEMS UNDER EVALUATION, never gold labels.

dataset_version.description: Version of the dataset this record belongs to.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 creation timestamp of the record.

random_seed.description: Seed used for any stochastic step in constructing this record.

cost.description: Generation cost in USD for this record, if measured. Do not report unmeasured values.

latency.description: Generation latency in seconds for this record, if measured. Do not report unmeasured values.
